transactions.slither_source_excerpt:
99:   function driver_authorizePayment(
100:     uint256 amount,
101:     uint256 maxAmount,
102:     uint16 /* feeBps - unused but kept for fuzzer parameter diversity */
103:   ) public {
104:     // Bound inputs to reasonable ranges
105:     amount = _boundAmount(amount);
106:     if (amount == 0) return; // Skip zero amounts
107:     maxAmount = amount; // Keep simple: maxAmount = amount
108: 
109:     bytes8 paymentRef = _getNextPaymentRef();
110: 
111:     // In Echidna, this contract IS the caller, so we use address(this) for all roles
112:     // Ensure this contract has tokens and has approved escrow
113:     token.mint(address(this), amount);
114:     supply += amount; // Track minted tokens
115:     token.approve(address(mockEscrow), amount);
116: 
117:     // Authorize payment (this contract acts as payer, we use different addresses for merchant/operator)
118:     try
119:       wrapper.authorizePayment(
120:         ERC20CommerceEscrowWrapper.AuthParams({
121:           paymentReference: paymentRef,
122:           payer: address(this), // This contract is the payer in Echidna
123:           merchant: MERCHANT,
124:           operator: address(this), // This contract is also operator to call capture/void
125:           token: address(token),
126:           amount: amount,
127:           maxAmount: maxAmount,
128:           preApprovalExpiry: block.timestamp + 1 hours,
129:           authorizationExpiry: block.timestamp + 1 hours,
130:           refundExpiry: block.timestamp + 2 hours,
131:           tokenCollector: address(0), // Use default collector
132:           collectorData: ''
133:         })
134:       )
135:     {
136:       // Track successful authorization
137:       totalAuthorized += amount;
138:     } catch {
139:       // Expected failures (e.g., zero amounts, invalid params)
140:     }
141:   }
